products.name: TrueNAS Mini X
products.summary: Compact 5+2-bay OpenZFS appliance with an Intel Atom C3558, 16 GB ECC DDR4, four 1GbE ports and IPMI.
products.description: The TrueNAS Mini X from iXsystems is a quiet 5+2-bay OpenZFS appliance with five 3.5-inch hot-swap SATA bays and two 2.5-inch SSD bays. It runs a quad-core Intel Atom C3558 with 16 GB DDR4 ECC (upgradeable to 32 GB), four 1GbE ports plus a dedicated IPMI port, and supports RAIDZ1/Z2, mirrors, snapshots and encryption.
products.keywords: truenas mini x ixsystems zfs nas ecc ipmi homelab

specs.interface: 5 x 3.5" SATA + 2 x 2.5" SATA SSD hot-swap

products.notes: iXsystems sells the Mini through its own configurator and resellers and publishes no fixed US list price on truenas.com; price is a TrueNAS diskless-unit estimate.

products.name: Toshiba MG11 24 TB Enterprise Capacity Hard Drive
products.summary: 24 TB 3.5-inch helium enterprise HDD with FC-MAMR, 10-disk design, 550 TB/year workload and SATA or SAS options.
products.description: The MG11 series is the top of Toshiba's Enterprise Capacity MG line, reaching 24 TB with Flux Control-Microwave Assisted Magnetic Recording on a helium-sealed 10-disk CMR platform. It supports 24/7 operation at 550 TB/year, Persistent Write Cache, RV sensors, 512e/4Kn flexible formatting, SIE/SED options and a 5-year warranty.
products.keywords: toshiba mg11 24tb enterprise hdd fc-mamr helium sata sas
products.notes: Toshiba publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 24 TB SATA model.

products.name: Toshiba N300 22 TB NAS Hard Drive
products.summary: 22 TB 3.5-inch 7200 RPM NAS drive with NASLink firmware, RV sensors and a 180 TB/year workload for 1-12 bay NAS.
products.description: Toshiba's N300 is built for 24x7 home-office and small-business NAS in up to 12-bay systems. The line tops out at 22 TB, spins at 7200 RPM with a 512 MB or 1024 MB buffer, uses NASLink firmware, Dynamic Cache and Stable Platter technology, and is rated for 180 TB/year with a 3-year warranty.
products.keywords: toshiba n300 22tb nas hdd 7200rpm naslink homelab
products.notes: Toshiba publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 22 TB model.

products.name: Solidigm D7-PS1010 7.68 TB PCIe 5.0 Data Center SSD
products.summary: PCIe 5.0 NVMe data center SSD with 176-layer TLC, up to 14,500 MB/s reads and 1 DWPD standard endurance.
products.description: The D7-PS1010 is Solidigm's first PCIe 5.0 data center SSD, built on 176-layer TLC 3D NAND in 1.92 TB to 15.36 TB capacities in E3.S and U.2 (plus E1.S). Solidigm quotes up to 14,500 MB/s sequential reads, up to 10,000 MB/s writes and 3.1M random read IOPS, 1.0 DWPD over five years and a 2.5 million-hour MTBF.
products.keywords: solidigm d7-ps1010 pcie gen5 nvme u.2 e3.s data center ssd
products.notes: Solidigm publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 7.68 TB U.2 drive.

products.name: Solidigm D7-P5520 3.84 TB PCIe 4.0 Data Center SSD
products.summary: PCIe 4.0 NVMe data center SSD with TLC 3D NAND, up to 7,100 MB/s reads and up to 1 DWPD.
products.description: The D7-P5520 is Solidigm's performance-tuned PCIe 4.0 x4 (NVMe 1.4) TLC SSD for mixed and read-intensive cloud and enterprise workloads. It comes in U.2 15 mm (1.92 TB to 15.36 TB), E1.S and E1.L form factors, with sequential reads up to 7,100 MB/s, writes up to 4,200 MB/s and endurance up to 1 DWPD over five years.
products.keywords: solidigm d7-p5520 pcie gen4 nvme u.2 data center ssd
products.notes: Solidigm publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 3.84 TB U.2 drive.

products.name: Solidigm D3-S4520 3.84 TB SATA Data Center SSD
products.summary: 2.5-inch SATA data center SSD with 144-layer TLC, up to 550/510 MB/s and more than 1 DWPD for HDD replacement.
products.description: The D3-S4520 is a SATA III data center SSD built on 144-layer TLC 3D NAND for read-intensive and mixed workloads in existing SATA servers. It comes in 2.5-inch 7 mm capacities from 240 GB to 7.68 TB (and M.2 boot sizes), with up to 550/510 MB/s sequential reads/writes, up to 92K/48K random IOPS, more than 1 DWPD endurance and a 5-year warranty.
products.keywords: solidigm d3-s4520 sata data center ssd 2.5 inch server boot
products.notes: Solidigm publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 3.84 TB 2.5-inch drive.

products.name: KIOXIA CD9P-R 7.68 TB PCIe 5.0 Data Center SSD
products.summary: Single-port PCIe 5.0 NVMe data center SSD with BiCS FLASH TLC, up to 14,800 MB/s reads and 1 DWPD.
products.description: The CD9P-R is KIOXIA's read-intensive data center NVMe SSD for hyperscale and cloud servers, in the 2.5-inch 15 mm form factor with a PCIe 5.0 x4 interface and NVMe 2.0. Capacities run from 1.92 TB to 61.44 TB with sustained sequential reads up to 14,800 MB/s, power-loss protection, SIE/SED options, 1 DWPD and a 5-year warranty.
products.keywords: kioxia cd9p cd9p-r pcie gen5 data center nvme ssd
products.notes: KIOXIA publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 7.68 TB SIE model.

products.name: Micron 7600 PRO 7.68 TB PCIe Gen5 Data Center SSD
products.summary: Mainstream PCIe Gen5 NVMe data center SSD on Micron G9 TLC NAND with up to 12,000 MB/s reads.
products.description: The Micron 7600 is a mainstream PCIe Gen5 x4 (NVMe 2.0d) data center SSD and the first in its class built on Micron's 9th-generation TLC NAND. The read-intensive 7600 PRO comes in 1.92 TB to 30.72 TB, with sequential reads up to 12,000 MB/s, OCP 2.5 support, E1.S, E3.S 1T and U.2 form factors and a 5-year warranty; the 7600 MAX is the mixed-use version.
products.keywords: micron 7600 pro pcie gen5 nvme u.2 e3.s data center ssd g9 nand
products.notes: Micron publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 7.68 TB U.2 drive.

products.name: Micron 6550 ION 61.44 TB PCIe Gen5 Data Center SSD
products.summary: 61.44 TB PCIe Gen5 NVMe capacity SSD on Micron G8 TLC NAND with 14,000 MB/s reads and 7,000 MB/s writes at 20 W.
products.description: The 6550 ION is Micron's PCIe Gen5 successor to the 6500 ION, built on G8 TLC NAND and billed as the first 60 TB SSD in the E3.S form factor. Micron specifies 14,000 MB/s sequential reads, 7,000 MB/s writes and 2,000K random read IOPS at a 20 W limit, with U.2 (15 mm), E3.S-1T and E1.L form factors, OCP 2.5 and SPDM 1.2 / FIPS 140-3 security.
products.keywords: micron 6550 ion 60tb 61.44tb pcie gen5 capacity ssd ai data lake
products.notes: Micron publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 61.44 TB drive.

products.name: Micron 5400 PRO 3.84 TB SATA Data Center SSD
products.summary: 2.5-inch SATA data center SSD on 176-layer NAND, 240 GB to 7.68 TB, up to 1.5 DWPD (PRO) and a 5-year warranty.
products.description: The Micron 5400 is Micron's 11th-generation data center SATA SSD and the first built on 176-layer NAND, offered in 2.5-inch 7 mm and M.2 22x80 form factors from 240 GB boot drives to 7.68 TB data drives. The read-intensive 5400 PRO offers up to 1.5 DWPD (the mixed-use 5400 MAX up to 5 DWPD), with AES-256 encryption, TCG Opal and a 5-year warranty.
products.keywords: micron 5400 pro sata data center ssd 2.5 inch server hdd replacement
products.notes: Micron publishes no US list price for this model (quote-only / sold through resellers); price is a TrustKart estimate for the 3.84 TB 2.5-inch drive.

products.name: HPE ProLiant DL20 Gen11
products.summary: Short-depth 1U single-socket rack server with Intel Xeon 6300 / Xeon E processors and up to 128 GB DDR5 ECC for edge and small offices.
products.description: The ProLiant DL20 Gen11 is HPE's compact 1U one-socket rack server with a 15.05-inch short-depth chassis for branch offices, retail, point-of-sale and space-limited sites. It takes dual- to octa-core Intel Xeon E or Xeon 6 processors and up to 128 GB of DDR5 ECC memory.
products.keywords: hpe proliant dl20 gen11 1u short depth edge server xeon e small business

specs.cpu: 1 x Intel Xeon 6300 / Xeon E (2 to 8 cores)

products.name: HPE ProLiant ML30 Gen11
products.summary: Entry single-socket tower server with Intel Xeon 6300 / Xeon E (up to 8 cores), up to 128 GB DDR5 ECC and 4 LFF or 8 SFF bays.
products.description: The ProLiant ML30 Gen11 is HPE's entry tower server for small businesses, supporting Intel Xeon 6300 or Xeon E processors up to 8 cores and 95 W. It uses DDR5 UDIMMs (4800 MT/s, up to 128 GB), offers 4 LFF non-hot-plug or hot-plug or 8 SFF hot-plug drive configurations, and ships with a 350 W power supply or optional 500/800/1000 W Flex Slot redundant supplies.
